I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I noted that the deadline for the signed order form at Tamsin Cold Chain is 24 September.

I also pointed out that the simulation clock says today is 14 October, so 24 September has already passed. I asked whether she meant a different date, or whether her post in #north-team needs correcting too.

I didn't change anything else, since she said no action was needed. The deadline is a date, not a money term, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.
